CustomField.formula: Tower__r.Project__r.Project_Code__c + "-" + IF(TEXT(Tower__r.Tower_Type__c) = "Commercial Block", "B", "T") + RIGHT("00" & TEXT(Tower__r.Tower_Number__c), 2) + "-F" + RIGHT("00" & TEXT(Floor__c), 2) + IF(TEXT(Tower__r.Tower_Type__c) = "Commercial Block", "-S", "-U") + RIGHT("000" & TEXT(Unit_Number__c), 3)
